q: How do I place an order?
a: Head to brew-and-bean.example/shop, pick your beans, and check out — card or PayPal. You'll get a confirmation email with tracking once it ships.

q: Do you offer decaf?
a: Yes — Decaf Midnight is our Swiss-water processed decaf, available in whole bean or ground. It's on the shop page under 'Decaf'.

q: Can I order as a gift?
a: Absolutely. Choose 'This is a gift' at checkout to add a note and have it shipped without prices. Gift cards are at brew-and-bean.example/gift.

q: What payment methods do you accept?
a: Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) and PayPal. Subscriptions are charged to the card on file on the 1st of each month.

q: How long does shipping take?
a: We roast to order and ship within 1-2 business days. Standard delivery is 2-5 business days; express is next-day in most metros. You'll get a tracking link by email.

q: Do you ship internationally?
a: We ship to the US, Canada, and the EU. International orders take 5-10 business days, and duties are the recipient's responsibility.

q: Is shipping free?
a: Standard shipping is free on orders over $35. Under that, it's a flat $4.95. Express starts at $9.95.

q: My order is late, where is it?
a: Check the tracking link in your email first. If it's been more than 7 business days, email support at support@example.com with your order number and we'll investigate within 24 hours.

q: How does the coffee subscription work?
a: Pick a blend and a cadence (every 2 or 4 weeks) and we roast + ship on that schedule. You can pause, swap blends, or cancel anytime from the Manage Plan page.

q: When is my next roast shipped?
a: Your plan page shows the next ship date. We roast the morning of dispatch, so what arrives is never more than a week off roast.

q: Can I pause my plan?
a: Yes — pause from the Manage Plan page up to 48 hours before the next ship date. Your beans, frequency, and discounts stay intact while paused.

q: How do I cancel my subscription?
a: Cancel anytime from Manage Plan > Cancel. You'll keep access until the end of the current billing period, and unused credit gets refunded.

q: What if I want to switch blends?
a: Swap your blend on the Manage Plan page before the next roast — the change applies to the upcoming shipment. If you're mid-cycle, both blends ship separately with no extra fee.

q: When was my coffee roasted?
a: Every bag is stamped with a Roast Date. We ship within 1-2 days of roasting, so your bag is usually 3-5 days off roast when it lands.

q: What grind should I choose?
a: If you use a drip machine or pour-over, choose 'Medium'. Espresso machines want 'Fine', French press wants 'Coarse'. Whole bean stays fresh longest.

q: How should I store my beans?
a: Keep them in the bag's one-way valve pouch, in a cool dark cupboard. Don't refrigerate — temperature swings stale coffee fast. Use within 4 weeks of the roast date.

q: What's your refund policy?
a: If a bag lands stale, damaged, or just isn't for you, email support within 14 days and we refund or replace — no return shipping needed.

q: How do I get a refund?
a: Email support@example.com with your order number and a one-line reason. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

q: My bag arrived damaged, what now?
a: Sorry about that — email a photo to support@example.com and we'll ship a replacement the same day, free.

q: How do I contact a human?
a: Email support@example.com — real humans, replies within a few hours on weekdays. For urgent order issues, mention 'urgent' in the subject line.

q: Do you have a physical store?
a: We're online-first, but you can find our beans at the farmers market stand in Portland every Saturday.
